views: view1 (บน): แปลนฐานรากแผ่และเสา 1:200 — spread footings F1-F4 (this split: _view1_footing_plan.json)
view2 (ล่าง): แปลนฐานรากตอกเข็มและเสา 1:200 — pile footings F1-F4 + columns C1-C5 (_view2_footing_plan.json)
warnings: No grid bubbles are printed on S-02; positions are read against the dimension chains (4.00 x 16 = 64.00; A-B 2.50, B-C 5.50, C-D 2.50, D-E 4.00) and named with the A-09 bubbles (see grid master).

Every position is printed as a column-footing pair 'Cn-Fm' (C1-F4, C2-F3, C3-F2, C4-F3, C5-F1). 48 positions: F4 x22 (rows A and D, grids 2, 3, 6-12, 15, 16), F3 x12 (A1, A17 under C2; B4, B5, B13, B14, C1, C4, C5, C13, C14, C17 under C4), F2 x10 (A4, A5, A13, A14, D1, D4, D5, D13, D14, D17 under C3), F1 x4 (E4, E5, E13, E14 under C5). Both views print the identical layout.

This is the pile-footing system (แปลนฐานรากตอกเข็มและเสา, details S-08: F1 one pile, F2 two piles, F3 three piles (triangular cap), F4 four piles). Listed first in the index A-02 ('แปลนฐานรากแบบตอกเข็มและเสา, แปลนฐานรากแผ่และเสา'), so it is treated as the primary system and carries the columns.

Columns C1-C5 are recorded here as point elements sharing the footings' grid_refs; column sizes per storey are on S-11 (schedule file). The rectangular columns C1/C2/C3 are drawn with their long side along y.
A small hatched square symbol is printed just below the C1-F4 label at D15 on this view only (not on view1); it carries no mark and was not recorded as an element.
Extra '2.50' printed inside the plan between grids 12-13 (rows C-D) repeats the C-D spacing; recorded in the grid master's chains.
